messages:
alex: Quick sync 1: proposing a compact follow-up cadence for postmortems. Pilot idea below, comments welcome.
maya: paste it here pls (attachments get buried).
alex: timeline draft:
```
Day 0: Contain + IC debrief + publish initial ack
Day 1-3: Assign remediation owners, open tracker issues
Day 7: Progress checkpoint (owners update status)
Day 10: Health check for long-running work (migrations, rollouts)
Day 14: Pattern review 6 flag recurring issues
Day 21: Verification & QA signoff, close actions
Day 30+: Monthly review for flagged recurring incidents
```

devon: small tweak: make Day 7 mandatory attendance for owners on the weekly sync. Also add a recurring-pattern tag in the tracker so platform can triage systemic work.
sam: on IC rotation: propose 2-week assignment windows, primary + backup. Never rotate mid-incident unless both agree.
maya: where do we store owners? the Google sheet is noisy and hard to query.
alex: propose using Linear with a dedicated project + issue template: fields = title, incident_ref, owner, ETA, verification_steps, status, recurring_tag. Make owner/ETA/verification required.
ops-bot: Action REM-2938 created by alex, assigned to devon, due 2067894000.
devon: i'll prototype the Linear project and template Monday. can someone draft a short, copy-pasteable comms format for the 15-min updates?
alex: comms cadence draft:
- Immediate: IC posts public ack (1 line: impact, owning team)
- Active incident: 15-min updates in channel, format: "Impact | Next step | Owner ETA"
- Post-incident: 3-hour summary to #incidents + product leads
- Follow-up: public action summary within 48h with owner + ETA

maya: please pin the exact 15-min template in the channel so people can copy it.
sam: also require channel pinned message listing IC + backup and a one-line escalation checklist.
devon: ops proposal: weekly 30-min follow-up sync for actions older than 7 days; owners expected to attend when they have open actions.
alex: pilot plan: run 4 sprints, measure time-to-owner, time-to-close, and recurrence rate. owners for pilot: alex (timeline + docs), devon (tracker prototype), maya (comms doc + pinned template), sam (IC rotation policy + roster).
maya: i'll drop the comms doc link in #docs by EOD tomorrow.
devon: will invite owners to the Linear project and seed a few template issues.
ops-bot: Calendar created: "Postmortem Follow-up Pilot - Weekly" starting 2067894100; attendees: alex, devon, maya, sam.
sam: good to go :thumbsup:
alex: i'll update the handbook with timeline + checklist and link back here. flag objections in 24h.
maya: no objections.
devon: none from me.
sam: fine by me.
